description: Seismic exposure data: Afghanistan is a series of data sets listed in Humanitarian Data Exchange, an open data portal, published or maintained by United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR). The GAR15 global exposure database is based on a top-down approach where statistical information including socio-economic, building type, and capital stock at a national level are transposed onto the grids of 5x5 or 1x1 using geographic distribution of population data and gross domestic product (GDP) as proxies. Coverage: Afghanistan. The portal lists 2 near-identical data sets in this series (one per year, period or area), grouped in this record; the first few are linked. The portal files it under the publisher United Nations Office for Disaster Risk Reduction (UNDRR). Its tags are disaster risk reduction-drr, geodata, hazards and risk. It offers 1 resource(s) in SHP. The portal shows 2016-01-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Other. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard and risk assessment. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-hdx-humanitarian-data-exchange.
